location: A small hill overlooking the road, away from the initial caravan position
timeContext: Daytime; approximately forty minutes after the party departed the city
physicalConditions: The caravan wagon is stationary on a hilltop observation point.
A Blight-Touched creature is circling the party, its form becoming more solid and dangerous.
The sealed water crate in the wagon is vibrating intensely due to resonance pressure.
Cracks are forming in the lead lining of the crate where the creature scored deep gouges.
Sulfur paste has been applied to disrupt the creature's cohesion but requires continuous use.
Elias and the party are on high alert, weapons drawn, preparing for an imminent surge attack.
knowledgeEstablished: The Blight-Touched entities are specifically drawn to the resonance of the sealed water crate.
The creature's form shifts between solid and gaseous states.
The sulfur paste disrupts the creature's cohesion but does not permanently neutralize it.
Torin successfully severed tendrils attempting to latch onto the rigging.
The party has established a temporary defensive perimeter on the hill.
The seal is under extreme pressure and nearing potential failure if the creature breaches it.
decisionsMade: The party moved from the road to a small hill for observation and defense.
Elias instructed Maren to prepare sulfur paste before the surge peaked.
Torin decided to keep cable tension tight and cut any tendrils latching onto rigging.
The party agreed to hold off until the surge peaks before striking back.
possessionChanges: Maren utilized flasks of sulfur paste from her saddlebag.
Kaelen activated a small barrier spell above the crate.
Torin used his scythe-like blade to sever creature tendrils.
relationshipChanges: Silas Vane was instructed to stay back and send for help if needed, though he is currently out of immediate focus.
The party's cohesion is reinforced through shared relief after the initial threat neutralization (from previous scene) and current coordinated defense.
completedActions: The caravan departed the city and established initial formation.
Maren calculated the surge window based on seal instability.
Elias instructed Silas to keep distance.
The party rode for an hour toward the foothills.
Maren warned that the seal's instability was peaking.
A Blight-Touched creature detached from the treeline and lunged at the crate.
Elias parried the creature's attack while Maren threw sulfur paste.
Kaelen raised a barrier spell to shield the crate.
Torin severed tendrils latching onto the rigging.
The party moved up a hill to set up an observation point.
The creature circled the party, growing more solid.
Elias and Maren prepared to strike when the surge peaked.
unresolvedImmediateAction: Elias is charging forward with his sword to intercept the Blight-Touched creature as it lunges again, while Maren stands ready to throw another flask of sulfur paste.
